# A Synthetic Trial of Structured Peer Tutoring and Student Test Scores

Avery Synthetic (2025). Synthetic fixture document for evaluation, not a real publication.

## Abstract
This synthetic study evaluates a structured peer-tutoring program delivered over one semester in a synthetic school district.

## Methods
Students in the synthetic dataset (N = 400) were assigned to structured peer tutoring or to business-as-usual instruction. Tutoring sessions ran twice weekly for twelve weeks.

## Results
Students who received structured peer tutoring showed test scores that improved by 7.3 percent relative to the comparison group at the end of the semester.

## Limitations
All data are synthetic and were generated for testing evidence-integrity tooling.
